prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production bitmap ICON SPRITESHEET for original Greek roguelite Paradise in Hell.
Input image: style reference ONLY. Match its crisp pixel-art, bronze square icon frames, deep navy inset background, strong small-scale silhouette and Greek myth theme. Do not copy the original symbols.
Primary request: a single sheet of EXACTLY EIGHT different square game icons in an invisible FOUR-column TWO-row grid. No text, letters, numbers, grid lines or watermark. Transparent gutters around each complete bronze-framed icon. Each tile centered within its cell, identical square frame dimensions and margins. Canvas1024x512. Sharp deliberate pixel clusters, no soft illustrative blur, readable when reduced to64x64 pixels. Same polish, palette and framing across every icon.
Order left to right:
Row1col1 AMPARO: one ivory hand protecting a small warm hearth flame, gold defensive aura, wine-red accent.
Row1col2 FUROR: a cracked bronze warrior helmet with glowing crimson eyes and small red heart, risk at low life.
Row1col3 FOLEGO: a luminous emerald laurel wreath around a small pair of lungs, recovering stamina.
Row1col4 RASTRO: a bronze winged sandal followed by three turquoise XP crystals being pulled behind it, dash collection.
Row2col1 EMBOSCADA: one golden arrowhead bursting from a winged sandal, a charged strike after dash.
Row2col2 CONVERGENCIA: two intertwined violet/amber runes meeting in a compact orange burst, burning/curse combination.
Row2col3 ECO_DO_ESTIGE: a small translucent cyan human echo standing inside concentric teal water ripples, violet deep-water accents.
Row2col4 ALTAR_FOLEGO: a bronze goblet overflowing with emerald light and a laurel leaf, permanent stamina upgrades.
Constraints: exactly8 self-contained icons in4by2 equal cells, no symbols spilling into adjacent cell, consistent bronze framed square plates, ample fully transparent gutters. No currency text, no characters from existing games, no white/checkerboard background.
